'''''Charger 2''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] used by the [[Nharwaak]]. It fought at the [[Battle of Mylok IV|Conflict at Mylok IV]] and, together with ''[[Charger 1]]'', formed the [[Charger Group]].
